Scenario fixture: live-region-announcements

Each target has a stable id of the form lra_case_NN. The page as it is when scanned; what the live-region hook records while a page runs is not part of a static fixture.

A. Live regions assistive technology can reach

01 — PASS: an empty status region, waiting for a message
02 — PASS: an alert with its message
Your session ends in 2 minutes.
03 — PASS: an assertive region hidden visually, still in the accessibility tree
04 — PASS: an output, a polite live region by default
3 items

B. A live region that may not be able to announce (CANTTELL)

05 — CANTTELL: a status region inside aria-hidden (LIVE_REGION_HIDDEN)
06 — CANTTELL: a polite region inside inert content (LIVE_REGION_HIDDEN)
07 — CANTTELL: a log left busy (LIVE_REGION_BUSY)

C. Left out (no occurrence)

08 — NEUTRAL: a toast container hidden until it is needed
09 — NEUTRAL: an alert turned off with aria-live="off"
